notes: ACCESS: robots.txt allows all bots incl. ClaudeBot/Claude-User (Allow: /). Tier(a) direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome) succeeded for the homepage and category pages (200 OK) and exposed a __NEXT_DATA__ JSON blob with the full mega-menu tree (globalContent.headerV2.slideOutMenu.categoryMenu) - used for TREE discovery (union of mega-menu; sitemap not separately needed since mega-menu was exhaustive and each category's own facet/sub-nav matched the menu). However tier(a) HTML/JSON does not expose product qty (loaded client-side via a middleware GraphQL call). Tier(b) Playwright headless was blocked by DataDome (captcha iframe returned for both homepage and category pages). Escalated to Playwright headed with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled per tier rules, which passed DataDome; qty required accepting the cookie-consent banner + several mouse-wheel scrolls to trigger the lazy product-count widget (div[class*=totalProductsWrapper], text 'N Products'). Never used Claude-in-Chrome (tier c) - not needed. QTY method: rendered FilterBar total-products text after scroll, cross-checked against canonical URL matching the requested category slug on every leaf. EXCLUDED: Wallpaper, Lighting, Mirrors, Decorative Accents/Accents, Vases/Vessels, Candles, Faux Florals, Tabletop Dinnerware/Bowls/Drinkware/Trays (Kitchen & Dining/Decorative Accessories task), all Furniture/Outdoor-furniture/Nursery-furniture/Kids-furniture nav branches, Umbrellas, Beach/Poolside (mixed lifestyle shop-all pages, not a clean textile/storage category), Rug Pads (underlay accessory, not a floor textile), Rug/Fabric/Wallpaper/Furniture Swatches (sample-ordering tool pages, not finished-product categories), Pillow Finder and Pillows By Color (color-facet filter links, not genuine distinct subcategories - would double count the Indoor/Outdoor Pillows universe), Pillow Inserts and Outdoor Pillow Inserts (canonical resolves to a single /products/ detail page, not a category listing), Bed Curtains (links directly to a /products/ detail page), Bathroom Decor/bedroom-bath-accessories (Decorative Home Accessories task), Kids > Baskets & Storage > Bookshelves (canonical is kids-furniture-shelves = Furniture), Sale/Clearance nav branch and 'New Arrivals' nav branch (promotional landing pages per rule 27/35), Build Your Perfect Bed / Sutter Collection / Bedding Visualizer / 3D Floorplanner (tools, not categories), Design/Inspiration/Services branch (site services). 'All X' / 'Shop All' parent links dropped wherever valid subcategories exist (rule 25/34) - e.g. All Bedding, All Bath, All Rugs, All Throw Pillows, All Throw Blankets, All Decor. MEDIUM-confidence rows: Jute/Wool/Flatweave/Runners Rugs, Indoor/Outdoor Pillows, Cotton&Linen/Alpaca&Wool Throws - these are real mega-menu-listed sub-categories with distinct verified product counts, but their <link rel=canonical> resolves to the shared parent listing (facet/department/material query-string filters), so they are flagged rather than HIGH. LOW-confidence row: Pajamas & Robes - single unsplit site category mixing apparel (excluded) with bathrobes (included); flagged for manual review since the exact qty split between the two is not exposed by the site. No genuine Storage-furniture (wardrobes/cabinets/dressers) found placed under a Storage nav branch - Serena & Lily's storage-adjacent furniture (dressers, nightstands, bookshelves) sits entirely under the Furniture mega-menu branch with no cross-listing under Storage/Organization, so excluded per storage.md rule 21/27.
